note: Generated from the MO Design System page. Never hand-edit a producer palette; read this file.

mode.rule: Light unless the asset renders inside someone else's dark chrome. Dark = YouTube, podcast apps, video overlays, studio backgrounds, deck punctuation.

retired.#0a0e17: old dark ground, superseded by dark-ground
retired.#64ffda: old mint accent, superseded by teal-bright
retired.#0d7377: old deep teal, superseded by teal-deep
retired.#F5F3EC: cream slide ground, superseded by ground
retired.#63797D: old soft grey, failed 4.5:1 on ground, superseded by soft
retired.#A8720B: old caution, failed 4.5:1 on light, superseded by semantic-high light
retired.#2F9E57: old light safe, failed 4.5:1 on light, superseded by semantic-low light
retired.#5f6d75: undocumented grey, duplicate of soft within 0.03:1 on every ground. Folded into soft #5A6E72 on 2026-09-11. Passed AA, so shipped assets are not re-rendered.
retired.#16333B: undocumented ghost-numeral navy. Folded into dark-motif #13313A.

usage_rules: teal #2F9E8D is a graphic colour on light, never body text. Use teal-deep for text and links.
soft is for light grounds only. On dark use on-dark-soft.
Semantic pairs differ by mode. Light uses the darkened set, dark uses the bright set. The meaning never changes.
One radial teal wash per dark canvas, 10 to 22 per cent. Never two, never on light.

display.use: asset titles, H1, slide and cover titles

heading.use: H2 to H4, card and slide titles

label.use: kickers, eyebrows, timestamps, figures, code. Every surface, including architecture diagrams.

rule.note: One weight. A heavier line must mean something.

scan-line.use: a name or title landing, once per piece

card.exception: diagram hold stays for the explained beat

motion.safe_band_9x16: middle 60 per cent; drop the day chip, centre the underline

canvas.document: A4 portrait, 14mm sides and top, 16mm foot

lockup.rule: Podcast lane carries METRICS & MAYHEM. Everything else carries MASTERING OBSERVABILITY.

ring-mark.clear_space: inner ring radius on all sides

crosshair.role: document and diagram furniture, top right

consumers.rule: A producer that defines a hex is a defect. Read this file through mo-tokens.js or mo_tokens.py.
consumers.build_check: Call assertNoRetired / assert_no_retired on your own source in the build. It fails on any retired hex.
